name: Baurutitan
sum: Baurutitan is a lithostrotian titanosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Brazil, distinguished by its caudal vertebrae and found in 1957.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MCT 1490-R, a caudal series (number read from the Commons image label).
material: Tail vertebrae; further material has been referred.
